description: Aggregate every matching federal award (same filters as search_awards) into totals per recipient, per resolved ticker, or per awarding agency: award count, total dollars, share, first and last award, largest award. Use this for "who won the most from the Navy this year" and similar questions; it counts all matches, not a page.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only rows on or after this date

until.description: ISO date; only rows on or before this date

name: award_totals
title: Award totals by recipient, ticker or agency
